source: Glossary of command terms, IB Economics guide (first assessment 2024). The assessment-objective grouping is verbatim from the guide; it is shared across DP subjects.

objectives.demand: These terms require students to learn and comprehend the meaning of information.
objectives.note: Recall. No argument, no evaluation — say the thing accurately and stop.

objectives.demand: These terms require students to use their knowledge and skills to break down ideas into simpler parts and to see how the parts relate.
objectives.note: Show the mechanism. Every claim needs a because.

objectives.demand: These terms require students to demonstrate the selection and use of subject-specific skills and techniques.
objectives.note: Method marks live here. Show working, label axes, state units.

objectives.demand: These terms require students to synthesise into a new whole and make judgments based on evidence or a set of criteria.
objectives.note: The marks are in the judgment, not the summary. Weigh both sides, then commit to a position and say why.
